```yaml
name: Sync AI Connector Docs

on:
  schedule:
    # Run every 6 hours
    - cron: '0 */6 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  sync-docs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout airbyte repo
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.OCTAVIA_BOT_TOKEN }}
          ref: main

      - name: Checkout airbyte-ai-connectors repo
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: airbytehq/airbyte-ai-connectors
          path: source-connectors
          token: ${{ secrets.OCTAVIA_BOT_TOKEN }}

      - name: Sync documentation files
        run: |
          DEST_DIR="docs/ai-agents/connectors"
          
          # Clean destination to ensure stale connectors are removed
          rm -rf "$DEST_DIR"
          mkdir -p "$DEST_DIR"
          
          # Copy .md files from each connector folder in the source repo
          # The source repo structure is assumed to be: source-connectors/<connector-name>/
          # We look for .md files in the root of each connector directory
          for connector_dir in source-connectors/*/; do
            if [ -d "$connector_dir" ]; then
              connector_name=$(basename "$connector_dir")
              # Check if there are any .md files in the connector directory
              if ls "$connector_dir"*.md 1> /dev/null 2>&1; then
                cp "$connector_dir"*.md "$DEST_DIR/"
                echo "Synced docs for connector: $connector_name"
              else
                echo "No .md files found for connector: $connector_name, skipping."
              fi
            fi
          done

      - name: Create Pull Request
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v6
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.OCTAVIA_BOT_TOKEN }}
          commit-message: "docs: sync AI connector docs from airbyte-ai-connectors"
          title: "docs: sync AI connector docs"
          body: |
            This PR automatically syncs AI connector documentation from the `airbyte-ai-connectors` repository.
            
            Changes:
            - Updated documentation for AI connectors.
            
            This PR was generated by the `sync-ai-connector-docs` workflow.
          branch: "sync-ai-connector-docs"
          delete-branch: true
          labels: |
            documentation
            auto-merge
```
